headline: F1 Citizens earning $15,000 or less get all wage tax back; at $15,001 they keep none of it: a $1,180 cliff (METR 1,583 % on the scanner grid)

scale.source: 40 PNC s 1104 as amended by RPPL 11-11 s 5 (in force 1 January 2023): the citizen refund limit ("earned fifteen thousand dollars ($15,000) or less")
scale.basis: 40 PNC s 1104 as amended by RPPL 11-11 s 5 (in force 1 January 2023): the citizen refund limit ("earned fifteen thousand dollars ($15,000) or less"). A statutory threshold, not an average wage: 1 'AW' in scanner output = this amount of annual income.

registry_correction: Registry 'Palau National Code title 40 (income tax; 2023 reform)': the 2023 reform kept a wage and salary tax (no general income tax for individuals): 6 % on the first $8,000, 10 % to $40,000, 12 % above, on all wages; citizens earning $15,000 or less get the whole tax refunded (40 PNC 1104); businesses pay the new Business Profits Tax and PGST.
